query:
SELECT pool_address
                  FROM pools
                 WHERE protocol = $1
                   AND first_seen_at <= COALESCE($2, 'infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ)
                   AND (first_seen_at < COALESCE($2, 'infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ)
                        OR pool_address < $3)
                 ORDER BY first_seen_at DESC, pool_address DESC
                 LIMIT $4
